the following: 1) the development of a data driven model for building energy dynamics, without physics based parameters; 2) a price based DR optimization problem for HVAC systems; 3) an MP strategy for the DSO to predict the DR schedules of the building operators; 4) a single level pricing strategy for DSO to implement optimal DR of HVACs; and 5) case studies to verify the performance of the proposed strategies.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed approach is a novel method for online learning and prediction of the optimal DR schedules of HVAC systems, which is a key to the practical implementation of price based demand response in commercial building clusters.

the proposed strategy can effectively exploit the operational flexibilities of the HVAC systems, while ensuring the voltage stability and occupants' thermal comfort, and thus make the price based DR application profitable.
the proposed approach is able to provide the DSO with an online prediction of the DR of HVAC systems, which can be used to optimize electricity prices and ensure grid stability.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed strategy can be used to effectively coordinate the price based DR of HVAC systems, which is a challenging task for a DSO, and the proposed MP based ANN is a powerful tool that can be used to replace the DR optimization problem, which would be very helpful for the implementation of a single level decision-making structure for optimal retail electricity pricing.

we propose a novel single level decision making framework for optimal electricity pricing, by leveraging the online learning capabilities of ANNs for meta prediction of the DR schedules of HVAC systems.
the proposed MP enabled ANN can be used to directly predict optimal DR schedules, so that the DSO can implement a single level decision strategy for optimal electricity pricing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by combining the ANN based meta prediction with the single level decision making, the optimal DR of the HVAC systems can be achieved, without the need for complex bi level decision making.
the MP enabled single level strategy provides a promising alternative for DSO to implement the price based DR of HVAC systems, without requiring the bi level decision making structure.
the proposed MP enabled single level strategy is a practical and efficient way to achieve optimal DR of HVACs for price based DR applications.
